verdict.rationale: YYLO orchestrates coding agents (e.g., Claude) to work a task end-to-end via `yylo init --task ... --subagent claude`, with worktree isolation and committed candidates (yylo-docs-1, yylo-docs-2, yylo-gh-4), supporting autonomous feature implementation. However, the docs explicitly state tests and semantic reviews are 'explicit project checks outside merge' and that merge 'launches no models, schedules no suites' (yylo-gh-6), meaning test-writing is not an integrated part of the agent's delivery flow but a separate manual/CI step. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the agent itself authors/executes tests as part of the task loop, and independent/hands-on confirmation of successful end-to-end feature+test delivery.
